title: Glow PvP
description: GlowPvP is a pvp practice server with its own tier list hosted in the Middle East (ME)
body:
# GlowPvP 
**GlowPvP** is a PvP training server that operates out of the Middle East (ME). The server has its own tier ranking system, enhanced performance for low latency, and different game modes to help you improve your game and move up the rankings.

### Links:

Donate: [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/akwes)

Discord: [GlowPvP](https://discord.gg/hCcuTR2SXp)

Website: [GlowPvP](https://glow-pvp.lovable.app/)
